title: Ulyana and the Witness
author: Emrys Amberdale
blurb: Tamsin Coldharbour, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
